title: Hardwood Garden Decking with LED Lights
description: Hardwood garden decking installed with recessed LED lights, creating a modern, durable and stylish patio space for everyday outdoor living in Bedford.
story: This project started with an unused and unmanaged area directly in front of the client’s French door. The space lacked structure and functionality, so the goal was to transform it into a modern, durable and visually appealing outdoor living area.

Site PreparationTo ensure a long‑lasting installation, we carried out a full preparation process:Removal of the existing surface and complete site clean‑upLevelling and stabilising the groundConstruction of a pressure‑treated timber frame suitable for outdoor conditionsThis solid foundation guarantees stability, drainage and long‑term performance.

Hardwood Decking InstallationWe installed a premium hardwood decking system, chosen for its:excellent durability and weather resistancewarm natural tones and elegant grainlong lifespan with minimal maintenanceEach board was fitted with precision to create a clean, modern and seamless finish.
Recessed LED LightingTo enhance both safety and atmosphere, we integrated recessed LED deck lights directly into the surface.

This lighting solution:creates a warm and inviting evening ambienceimproves visibility around the French doorhighlights the natural beauty of the hardwood deckingAll wiring was discreetly installed and fully protected for outdoor use.
Final ResultThe transformation delivers a stylish, practical and long‑lasting patio area, perfect for everyday outdoor living.
The combination of hardwood decking and integrated LED lighting adds value, comfort and a premium finish to the property.

title: Wooden Garden Pergola
description: Enhance your garden with a stylish wooden pergola and porcelain patio. Ideal for modern outdoor living and durable, low-maintenance landscaping.
story: In this garden project, we installed a modern wooden pergola combined with a porcelain tiled patio, creating a sleek and low-maintenance outdoor living area. To enhance rainwater management, we added a discreet yet effective drainage improvement: in the back-right corner, we excavated to a depth of 80 cm and installed a soakaway system. The trench was filled with limestone, a naturally water-repellent aggregate that helps efficiently absorb and redirect excess rainwater away from the patio surface.

This soakaway drainage solution offers several advantages. It reduces surface water buildup, minimises the risk of puddles, and extends the lifespan of outdoor materials by preventing water damage and erosion. It’s also a low-maintenance, eco-friendly option, as it allows water to naturally filter back into the ground. However, soakaway systems are most effective in well-draining soil types and may not be suitable for areas with high clay content or limited permeability. Proper planning and installation depth are essential to ensure long-term performance.

Overall, this solution improves the functionality and durability of the patio while maintaining a clean and uncluttered look. Perfect for those looking for stylish yet practical patio drainage ideas, this project showcases how to combine aesthetic appeal with smart landscaping. Ideal for anyone considering a wooden pergola for the garden or planning a modern garden renovation with integrated water management.

title: Garden Makeover with Porcelain Paving and Fresh Turf
description: Transform your outdoor space in Kempston with a garden renovation, featuring porcelain paving and lush new turf—perfect for low-maintenance gardens.
story: This recent garden project in Kempston gave a worn and underused outdoor space a complete refresh. The goal was to create something modern, neat, and low maintenance ideal for everyday use and built to last through the seasons.

Before the Work BeganThe garden was flat but looked tired and unloved. The existing block paving had become dated and uneven, and there was a small wooden deck that had started to deteriorate. The grass was patchy, with poor drainage, and the whole space lacked a clear layout or purpose. It wasn’t very welcoming and certainly wasn’t being used to its full potential.

What We Wanted to AchieveRework the layout for better use of spaceReplace the old paving with modern, slip-resistant porcelain tilesInstall a new, healthy lawn with clean edges and proper drainageKeep everything low maintenance and weather resistantAdd a simple, contemporary look that lifts the feel of the gardenWhat We Did1. Clearing and Ground PreparationWe started by removing the existing paving, timber decking, and damaged turf. Once cleared, we prepared the ground evenly across the entire garden, ensuring a solid base for both the turf and the porcelain paving.2. Installing Porcelain PavingWe laid high-quality outdoor porcelain slabs for the main walkway and patio area. These tiles are perfect for all-weather use —non-slip, easy to clean, and durable. To finish it off, we added a contrasting dark edging that frames the paving and gives a sharp, clean look.3. Laying the New TurfA fresh, level lawn was installed on top of a properly prepared sublayer. The turf was rolled out carefully for a uniform finish, and the result is a lush, green space with crisp edges and that classic striped look.4. Decorative Gravel BorderWe finished the space with a decorative gravel strip along the fence. This improves drainage, keeps weeds at bay, and adds a neat contrast between the paving and the fencing.

Why Porcelain Paving is a Great Choice for KempstonPorcelain tiles are one of the best options for outdoor spaces in Kempston. They’re hard wearing, slip resistant, and require very little upkeep. Unlike natural stone, they don’t absorb moisture, which means they stay cleaner for longer and are less prone to moss or staining.

The ResultThe transformation is clear. The garden is still flat, but it now has structure, flow, and style. With the clean paving, vibrant lawn, and smart finishes, the space feels bigger, brighter, and much easier to maintain. It’s a great example of how a simple layout, done well, can totally change the feel of a garden.
If you're thinking about renovating your garden in Kempston, this project shows how high-quality materials and thoughtful design can make a lasting difference even on a single-level plot.

title: Front Garden Revamp with Sandstone Paving & Gate
description: Transform your front garden with Sunset Buff sandstone paving and a stylish black metal gate for a modern, low-maintenance, and secure outdoor space.
story: This front garden makeover brings a simple and functional upgrade with a focus on Sunset Buff sandstone paving and a smart metal front garden gate. The new sandstone patio immediately transforms the space, providing a clean, modern, and stylish look while being durable and easy to maintain. The warm, natural tones of Sunset Buff sandstone blend seamlessly with the property’s brickwork, creating a welcoming first impression. Its smooth yet textured surface ensures it’s both attractive and practical for everyday use, making it an excellent choice for front garden landscaping.

The addition of a black metal front garden gate adds a touch of elegance, style, and security to the space. The sleek black finish provides a timeless appeal, offering a striking contrast to the sandstone paving and brick pillars. This sturdy and well-fitted gate enhances the garden's curb appeal while keeping the area secure and tidy, making it perfect for modern front garden designs and landscape security gates.

Together, the Sunset Buff sandstone patio and metal garden gate elevate the garden's appearance without overcomplicating it. This thoughtful and stylish upgrade is ideal for homeowners seeking a low-maintenance front garden with a clean, contemporary, and inviting entrance. These design elements are perfect for boosting curb appeal, increasing property value, and creating a functional yet attractive outdoor space.

title: Grey Composite Gate Upgrade
description: Enhance security and style with a grey composite gate. Durable, weatherproof, low-maintenance, and perfect for the British climate, it’s ideal for side access.
story: This project involved replacing an aging wooden gate with a modern grey composite gate, offering an ideal solution for enhancing security, privacy, and aesthetics. The new gate is crafted from high-quality composite materials, which are resistant to warping, rotting, and weather damage —making it a perfect low-maintenance choice for the British climate and outdoor conditions.

The sleek grey design adds a stylish and contemporary touch to the space, beautifully contrasting with the red brick walls to create an elegant yet functional upgrade. This durable composite side gate not only improves the overall look of the property but also provides enhanced safety through its robust locking mechanism. It is particularly well-suited for securing side access points, outdoor pathways, and narrow spaces.

Unlike traditional wooden gates, which require regular painting or treatment, this composite gate offers a no-fuss, low-maintenance solution that saves time and effort over the years. Its weatherproof design ensures a long-lasting performance, withstanding rain, wind, and other elements without compromising its appearance or structural integrity.

By upgrading to a grey composite gate, this project successfully combines modern design, superior functionality, and practical benefits. It is a durable, weatherproof choice for homeowners seeking an attractive yet highly secure and low-maintenance solution for their side or garden access points.

title: Bespoke Cedar Wood Fencing for Privacy and Kerb Appeal
description: New cedar wood fencing installation with horizontal slats, enhancing privacy, durability, and modern kerb appeal.
story: Here we have a professional transformation featuring the replacement of an older, weathered brick wall with bespoke cedar wood fencing. By utilising high-quality cedar timber, this project has significantly enhanced the property's kerb appeal, delivering a clean, modern aesthetic that stands out. Cedar wood, renowned for its durability, sturdiness, and natural resistance to rot, was carefully selected to ensure a long-lasting fence while maintaining a visually appealing finish.

The clean lines of the timber panels perfectly complement the block-paved driveway, creating a seamless and inviting appearance. The horizontal slat design not only modernises the space but also offers privacy while enhancing the sense of openness. In comparison to the previous iron fencing and brick base, this new installation provides a cleaner, more low-maintenance solution for homeowners.

The use of cedar wood also ensures an eco-friendly touch, as it’s a sustainable, natural material that requires minimal treatment. Expert craftsmanship guarantees the fence’s alignment and durability against challenging British weather conditions. Ideal for homeowners seeking a stylish yet practical fencing solution, this project exemplifies precision in design, superior materials, and professional landscaping excellence.

Whether upgrading old structures or enhancing outdoor spaces, this installation demonstrates how high-quality cedar wood fences can significantly transform a property’s exterior, providing both privacy and a lasting, attractive finish.

title: Lawn Revamp: Professional Lawn Care and Restoration
description: messy front yard into a neat, easy-to-care-for lawn. Fresh grass, tidy flower beds, and clear borders make the space more inviting and attractive
story: The transformation of this front garden has seen it go from a cluttered and tired space to a beautifully restored and tidy lawn area. Before the work was undertaken, the garden featured a patchy, uneven lawn, surrounded by overgrown shrubbery and disorganised planting areas. The layout lacked cohesion, with random sections of gravel and neglected plants that detracted from the garden’s potential.

The landscaping work has completely revitalised the space. The old lawn has been removed and replaced with fresh, newly laid turf, creating a smooth and level surface that instantly improves the overall look of the garden. The messy gravel borders have been cleaned up, and the surrounding flower beds have been redefined with fresh soil and compost, ready for future planting. The removal of the overgrown bushes and shrubs has opened up the space, making it appear larger and more welcoming.

The garden is now framed by well-defined metal edges, which contrast beautifully against the lush green turf and the existing paved driveway. The overall design is much more functional and visually appealing, creating a fresh and inviting outdoor area that is low-maintenance and ready for the homeowners to enjoy. This revamp has brought new life to the previously neglected space.

title: Mint Fossil Sandstone Paving & Cotswold Gravel
description: This overgrown garden was transformed into a modern space with sandstone paving, gravel, and defined zones for dining and relaxation. Stylish, low-maintenance, and perfect for outdoor enjoyment.
story: This garden has undergone a significant transformation, changing from an overgrown, unused space into a beautifully landscaped area perfect for relaxation. Before the renovation, the garden was covered in unkempt grass, with uneven ground and a lack of clear design or purpose. The space felt cluttered and neglected, with wild patches of grass overtaking the area and no defined sections for walking or entertaining.

Following the renovation, the garden has been completely revitalised. The new design features a large paved area with 900mm sandstone slabs, creating a smooth and inviting surface ideal for outdoor seating or dining. The slabs have been laid with precision, bordered by neat wooden framing and gravel for a clean, modern finish. An adjoining section filled with gravel offers low-maintenance functionality while adding a contemporary contrast to the stone paving. Perfect area for the customer’s dog to use as well.

This combination of natural stone and gravel gives the garden a fresh, stylish look, with clear zones for different activities. The overall layout is much more structured and easy to maintain, providing a welcoming space for outdoor enjoyment. The once neglected garden has been transformed into a modern, usable area that enhances the aesthetic and practical appeal of the home.

title: Nustone Porcelain Patio
description: This garden patio was transformed from worn concrete slabs to modern porcelain tiles with sleek granite borders and decorative stones, creating a clean, contemporary outdoor space.
story: The work carried out in this garden has resulted in a complete transformation of the patio area. Prior to the renovation, the patio was laid with outdated, weathered concrete paving slabs that had become discoloured and uneven over time. The slabs showed signs of wear and moss growth, which gave the space a neglected appearance. The edges of the patio were not well defined, blending unevenly into the lawn, contributing to a lack of structure in the garden.

Following the renovation, the old slabs have been replaced with sleek, modern porcelain tiles in a soft beige tone (supplied by Nustone), giving the space a much more contemporary and clean look. The new paving has been expertly laid, with straight lines and well-defined borders, creating a seamless transition between the patio and the lawn. The granite border provides a neat, polished finish, with their different material texture and tone. White decorative stones have been added around the edges, enhancing the modern aesthetic and offering contrast against the new paving.

This renovation has not only improved the appearance of the garden but also created a more functional, low-maintenance outdoor space that is perfect for entertaining or relaxing in a modern setting. More work to come on this garden, with new lawn installation booked in.

title: Garden Makeover: White Porcelain & Grey Composite Decking
description: Garden transformation features a structured lawn, sleek porcelain patio, modern composite decking, and Venetian-style fencing, creating a functional, stylish space for relaxation and entertaining.
story: The landscaping work undertaken in this garden transformation involved a complete overhaul of the outdoor space. Previously, the garden featured a patchy lawn and an uneven patio area. The layout was unstructured, with minimal design, and the overall appearance was quite plain. The existing lawn was uneven, and the patio paving was dated and weathered, creating an unattractive look. A wooden deck area and shed occupied one side of the garden, further adding to the disorganised and cluttered appearance.

Post-renovation, the space has been completely revitalised. The lawn has been raised and neatly framed with railway sleepers, giving the garden a structured and modern look. The new turf is lush and evenly laid out. The garden now features a pristine patio porcelain area with 600mm sleek tiles, surrounded by decorative white pebbles for added texture and contrast. The new venetian style fencing adds privacy and a contemporary touch, enhancing the aesthetic appeal of the entire space.

Additionally, a dedicated seating area has been created using modern composite decking, as well as a BBQ area on the lower side of the garden, providing perfect spots for relaxation and utility. The overall design is clean, with a minimalist, modern feel. The transformation results in a more functional, aesthetically pleasing garden that is ideal for both leisure and entertaining.

title: Double Blue Bullnose Brick Raised Flower Bed
description: Carefully crafted raised brick flower bed with bullnose edging, filled with fresh soil, offering durability, refined design, and improved garden aesthetics
story: The work undertaken involved the creation of a carefully crafted raised brick flower bed. This newly constructed bed serves as an attractive and functional addition to the garden. Built with precision, the bed is composed of brick, providing both durability and a classic look, and a clear upgrade to the old and rotten sleepers’ flower bed. The structure features a smooth, rounded top edge, adding a touch of refinement and ensuring it is safe and comfortable to sit on or work around. The brickwork has been executed with clean, straight lines, ensuring a professional finish that complements the surrounding garden environment.

The interior of the raised bed has been filled with fresh soil and compost, making it ready for planting. This provides an ideal growing environment for flowers, shrubs, or other plants, as the raised design allows for improved drainage and soil aeration. The bed is neatly positioned along a new fence, making efficient use of space while enhancing the overall aesthetic of the area.

In addition to the bed itself, the surrounding garden area has been cleared and prepared, ensuring the bed integrates well into the existing landscape. The overall effect is a more organised, practical, and visually appealing space, suitable for both gardening and relaxation in the garden

title: Patio Upgrade: From Decking to Stone Paving
description: Transformation of an outdoor space replacing timber decking with the modern stone patio, paired with refreshed brickwork, creates a durable, stylish,.
story: The transformation of this outdoor area has replaced an old, worn timber decking with modern, elegant sandstone paving. The previous deck was weathered and faded, with wooden railings that gave the space a dated appearance. Over time, the timber had begun to deteriorate and rot, with visible signs of ageing and water damage, making the area less appealing and practical for outdoor use.

The recent work has completely overhauled this space by removing the tired decking and replacing it with a beautifully laid stone patio. The new paving stones offer a more durable and stylish finish, enhancing the overall look of the garden. The slabs have been expertly laid, providing a smooth, level surface that is both practical and visually appealing. The transition from timber to stone brings a more modern and clean aesthetic to the space.

In addition, the brickwork beneath the patio has been refreshed, providing a sturdy foundation that complements the sleek new paving. Complementing the grey sandstone, we’ve used blue engineering bricks on this one.

The area is now much easier to maintain and offers a more inviting atmosphere for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. This upgrade has significantly improved both the appearance and functionality of the garden, creating a timeless and low-maintenance feature.

title: Light White Porcelain Patio with Polished Sleepers
description: Transform your patio with light grey porcelain tiles and polished sleepers. A modern, low-maintenance design perfect for stylish outdoor living and entertaining.
story: The landscaping work carried out has transformed a worn and damaged patio into a sleek, modern outdoor space. Previously, the patio consisted of uneven, dark paving slabs that had shifted and deteriorated over time. The original patio had visible cracks and gaps, with some sections sunken and water pooling on the surface. This gave the area a neglected and uninviting appearance, reducing the functionality of the outdoor space.

After the renovation, the old slabs have been removed and replaced with large, light grey porcelain tiles. The new tiles are laid in clean, straight lines, creating a contemporary and spacious feel. The porcelain finish adds a sophisticated, polished look, while also being durable and easy to maintain. The new patio is bordered with railway sleepers that have been sanded and varnished, providing a neat and well-defined separation between the patio and the lawn. Decorative gravel has been placed along the edges of the house for an additional design feature and drainage improvement.

This complete overhaul has resulted in a much more attractive and practical space for outdoor living. The new design offers a low-maintenance, modern aesthetic that enhances the overall appeal of the garden, making it an ideal setting for relaxation and social gatherings. A new aluminium pergola has also been installed following the finished patio. Check out our social media for more info!

title: Garden Transformation: Artificial Grass and Porcelain
description: Transform your garden with artificial grass and sleek porcelain tiles. See how this landscaping project turned an overgrown, cluttered space into a modern, low-maintenance outdoor area
story: The landscaping work has completely transformed the garden from a disorganised and overgrown area into a clean, modern outdoor space. Initially, the garden featured an uneven natural lawn with patches of weeds and outdated patio slabs that had shifted over time, with grass growing between the cracks. The garden lacked structure and a polished appearance, giving it a neglected and cluttered feel.

Following the work carried out, the area has been significantly improved. The old, patchy grass has been replaced with high-quality artificial turf, offering a lush and uniform appearance. This new lawn is easy to maintain and provides a fresh, green look year-round. A neat brick border has been installed along the edges of the lawn, giving it a tidy and structured finish. Additionally, new sleek, grey porcelain tiles have been laid, creating a smooth, modern patio area. The paving is well-aligned, and decorative stones have been added along the sides for a crisp and contemporary touch.

The overall result is a much more organised, stylish, and functional garden space that is perfect for relaxation or entertaining, with minimal upkeep required compared to the previous layout. Kids and the whole family loves it!

title: Closeboard Fencing for Strengthened Security
description: Strengthen garden security with closeboard fencing, concrete posts, and gravel boards for privacy and durability.
story: This landscaping project features the installation of closeboard fencing with concrete posts and gravel boards, a top choice for garden security and long-term durability. This fencing solution not only boosts the garden’s appearance but also significantly enhances boundary privacy and protection. The before image shows the deterioration of the old wooden fence, which had collapsed due to weathering and structural weaknesses, making the garden perimeter both unsightly and unsafe.

The newly installed closeboard fencing provides a strong, attractive, and durable boundary. Closeboard fencing, known for its overlapping vertical wooden boards, is perfect for maintaining privacy and withstanding harsh weather conditions. The concrete fence posts offer a sturdy foundation that resists rot and can withstand strong winds, making them ideal for long-lasting garden security. Additionally, gravel boards at the base of the fence help protect the wooden panels from moisture, extending the life of the fence.

This fence installation enhances both the security and aesthetic appeal of the garden, providing a clean, modern look while strengthening the garden's perimeter. The addition of durable, weather-resistant materials makes this an ideal choice for homeowners looking for a low-maintenance, long-lasting fencing solution that adds value to their property.

With this new installation, the garden benefits from improved structural stability and a polished, professional finish, offering a significant upgrade from the previous collapsed fence. Whether you're looking to improve your garden's privacy, aesthetics, or security, this closeboard fencing with concrete posts and gravel boards is an excellent solution for any homeowner.

title: Mint Fossil Sandstone Autumn Paving
description: Sandstone paving is a popular choice for outdoor spaces due to its natural beauty and durability. It comes in various colours and textures…
story: This garden was due for a change, and that's exactly what we've done. After clearing away the golden gravel, concrete slabs, shed base (not shown in the photo), tree stumps, and overgrown foliage, we started preparing the ground for the new paving. We then installed a 36 square meter patio using Mint Fossil Sandstone, bordered with Autumn block paving. Towards the back end of the patio, we added topsoil and compost, getting it ready for future planting.

Our focus was on simplifying and enhancing the space without unnecessary embellishments. The removal of the existing elements was done to create a clean slate, and the new patio, while sizeable, is designed to be practical and understated. The choice of materials reflects a balance between durability and a natural look, and the subtle addition of topsoil and compost provides an opportunity for future greenery without overwhelming the space.

title: Aluminium Pergola fitted on Grey Composite Decking
description: Louvered Pergola on composite decking can be a stylish and durable addition to your outdoor space. Ensure proper support and anchoring for the pergola on the decking, considering the weight
story: We transformed this plain and underused patio into a beautiful and functional outdoor space by installing composite decking and a modern pergola with a louvered roof.

Before the project began, the area was covered with old, uneven paving slabs that had seen better days. Although it connected directly to the home, it lacked comfort, style, and practicality — and it wasn’t being enjoyed to its full potential. The goal was to create a clean, comfortable, and modern outdoor area that could be used every day, in any season.

We started by removing the existing stone and preparing the base for the new decking. We chose composite decking for its durability, clean finish, and minimal maintenance needs. Unlike traditional timber, composite boards won’t rot, warp, or need regular painting or sealing — perfect for a hassle-free garden lifestyle.

The main feature of this upgrade is the pergola with louvered roof for sun and shade. This sleek, aluminium structure includes a fully adjustable roof system. With a simple mechanism, the slats can be tilted or closed completely, allowing full control over sunlight, ventilation, and protection from rain. On bright days, it can be opened to enjoy the sun; when it’s hot or drizzling, the roof can be closed to create a comfortable, shaded area.

This kind of adjustable roof pergola for garden use is ideal for creating a versatile outdoor living zone — a space where you can relax, entertain guests, or simply enjoy your garden from morning to evening, no matter the weather.

The result is a stylish, low-maintenance, and practical outdoor area that feels like a true extension of the home. It not only improves the look of the garden but also adds real lifestyle value, turning a once dull space into a beautiful and enjoyable part of the property.

title: Front Garden Renewal with Porcelain
story: In this project, simplicity meets effectiveness as we undertook a transformation guided by the detailed preferences of the customer. The focal point of this endeavour is a small, yet impactful path created with light-coloured Grey Porcelain. The path is not just a functional element but a carefully curated addition that seamlessly integrates with the overall aesthetic.

The path is thoughtfully edged with Railway Sleepers, strategically painted to match the colour of the back garden fence. This attention to detail ensures a cohesive and harmonious visual appeal. The integration of flower beds alongside the path adds both charm and functionality, creating a versatile space that can be utilized for various purposes.

title: Camel Dust Sandstone with Block Paving
description: Build outdoor space: To maximize the usable space and breathe new life into the outdoor area, we extended the patio by an additional 1.2 meters.
story: Embarking on a comprehensive refresh, we transformed the old patio, characterized by largely broken slabs and overgrown bushes. The customer opted for a complete overhaul, and we initiated the project by clearing the entire area, including the removal of bushes.

To maximize the usable space and breathe new life into the outdoor area, we extended the patio by an additional 1.2 meters. The focal point of the transformation was the installation of sandstone, covering an expansive area of approximately 28 square meters. This not only replaced the worn-out patio but also created a versatile space that can be enjoyed throughout the year.

In addition to the patio, we strategically connected the house to the garage with a thoughtfully designed path. This not only added practicality to the outdoor layout but also contributed to the overall cohesiveness of the space.

title: Camel Dust Low Maintenance Garden
description: We opted for Camel Dust Sandstone paving, covering around 18 square meters and 40mm Artificial Grass lawn, bordered with simple Autumn block paving.
story: After engaging in thoughtful conversations with our clients to grasp their preferences, we set out to enhance a garden that might have seemed plain initially. Our aim was to create a space that not only demands less upkeep but also expands the usable area.

We opted for Camel Dust Sandstone paving, covering around 18 square meters, connecting the main patio to a pathway for easy access. The centrepiece is a 40mm Artificial Grass lawn, bordered with simple Autumn block paving. To add a touch of nature, two flower beds were crafted using Railway Sleepers, filled with topsoil and compost, awaiting the planting phase.

Our intention was to keep things straightforward and practical, ensuring the garden becomes an enjoyable space without unnecessary complexities. The chosen elements are easy to maintain and contribute to a modest yet appealing transformation.

title: Grey Sandstone with Raised Beds, Lawn, Closeboard Fence
description: Opting for Grey Sandstone, we meticulously laid the patio and accentuated its edges with Charcoal Granite bricks. The finishing touch came in the form of Jet Black EasyJoint grout.
story: Commencing the transformation of a neglected garden, we initiated the process by clearing the space, turning it from a state of disarray to a clean slate. The first step involved levelling the area designated for the patio, creating an inviting introduction to the rest of the garden.

Opting for Grey Sandstone, we meticulously laid the patio and accentuated its edges with Charcoal Granite bricks. The finishing touch came in the form of Jet Black EasyJoint grout, enhancing both the visual appeal and structural integrity of the patio. To introduce greenery and structure, Raised Flower Beds were constructed using sturdy Railway Sleepers, generously filled with topsoil and compost in anticipation of future plantings.

The left side of the flower beds received an added aesthetic element with the installation of a new Closeboard Fence, spanning two different heights. This not only marks the boundary but also adds a vertical dimension to the garden's design.

The final flourish involved flattening the remaining area and laying a fresh new lawn, completing the overall aesthetic, and ensuring a harmonious transition from patio to green space. This comprehensive transformation is a testament to our commitment to creating outdoor environments that are both visually appealing and fun.

title: Mint Fossil Sandstone with Luxurious Artificial Grass
description: Adding mint fossil sandstone flags: the green tones and fossil patterns can add a touch of natural beauty to your outdoor space.
story: In this project, we've elevated a plain concrete paving to a sophisticated Mint Fossil Sandstone, enhancing the aesthetic appeal significantly. Responding to our customer's request, we went the extra mile by integrating a plush 40mm artificial grass, providing a secure and ample play area for their children. To ensure safety, we included a soft underlay as a cushioning pad.

A key feature of the transformation is the raised bed at the far end of the area. This clever use of space not only adds visual interest but also aligns with our commitment to low-maintenance landscaping. The result is not only a visually appealing outdoor space but also one that minimizes upkeep.

The customer's satisfaction was evident, and their enthusiasm extended to an inquiry about completing a similar transformation in the front garden. This project stands as a testament to our dedication to meeting customer preferences and creating outdoor spaces that seamlessly blend aesthetics with functionality.

title: Kandla Sandstone and Raised Flower Beds
description: A complete garden makeover, consisting of 3 bespoke patios, each for a different use, joined by a path across the garden.
story: We initiated this project by clearing the canvas, ridding the garden of overgrown shrubs and small trees at the back and side. The patchy lawn also made way for a fresh start. The next step involved the installation of raised beds on either side, where attention to detail extended to painting them to seamlessly match the existing fence, harmonizing with the overall aesthetic.

To optimize the use of space and introduce a captivating, tiered layout, the entire garden was strategically divided into three tiers. Kandla Grey Sandstone paving took centre stage, seamlessly integrating with the existing garden office that the customer had previously installed. The edges of the paving were meticulously bordered with Charcoal block paving, providing both structure and visual contrast. The finishing touch came in the form of Jet Black Easy Joint compound grouting, ensuring durability and a polished appearance.

A lush, new lawn, carefully laid atop a fresh layer of topsoil, added a touch of greenery, completing the revitalization. The result left the customers elated with the transformation, a testament to our commitment to precision, aesthetics, and customer satisfaction.

title: New Patio with White Porcelain
description: How a complete patio makeover transformed a cluttered outdoor space, modern oasis. From broken paving slabs to contemporary porcelain tiles, see the stylish and functional redesign that enhanced both aesthetics and usability.
story: The recent landscaping work has completely transformed a tired and cluttered outdoor space into a sleek and stylish patio. Before the renovation, the area consisted of uneven, broken paving slabs that had become weathered and damaged over time. The original patio was cluttered with overgrown shrubs and untidy, which reduced the overall usability and aesthetic appeal of the space. The layout felt cramped, with no clear flow from the house to the garden.

Now, the space has been entirely revitalised. The old, worn slabs have been replaced with large, contemporary porcelain tiles that offer a smooth and polished finish. These new tiles give the patio a fresh, modern appearance and are easy to maintain. The path along the side of the house has also been upgraded, providing a seamless transition from the back garden to the front of the house. Decorative white gravel borders the tiles, adding texture and contrast while improving drainage. We also added LED lights embedded into the railway sleepers’ edging, further adding to the stylish and modern appeal.

The garden feels more open and inviting, with a much more practical and stylish design. This complete patio makeover has not only enhanced the garden’s visual appeal but also made it a more functional and welcoming space for outdoor living and entertaining.

title: Simple Makeover with Railway Sleepers and Lawn
description: The introduction of Railway Sleepers on either side of the garden marked a significant enhancement.
story: We breathed a bit of new life into this garden with a simple yet effective makeover. The initial phase involved the removal of the existing grass, overrun with weeds. To establish a clean slate, we levelled the entire area, setting the groundwork for a fresh start.

The introduction of Railway Sleepers on either side of the garden marked a significant enhancement. Strategically positioned, these sleepers not only created raised flower beds but also served as a protective border. This not only prevented neighbouring plants from encroaching through the fence but also added a tidy and organized aesthetic to the garden.

The existing concrete slabs underwent a rejuvenating Power Wash, restoring their original lustre. To complete the transformation, a new lawn was laid atop a fresh layer of topsoil and compost mix, ensuring optimal conditions for healthy growth.

title: Shaped Raised Beds with Railway Sleepers
description: The central feature of the project was the construction of a grey composite decking than we built Raised Beds creating an environment for various shrubs
story: While transforming this garden, our first step was the removal of all existing concrete paving and gravel, with some of the latter being retained and supplemented. The central feature of the project was the construction of a grey composite decking, although not visible in the provided photo, it was installed and equipped with LED lights for both functionality and ambiance.

To introduce depth and greenery, we built Raised Beds using durable Railway Sleepers. These beds were carefully filled with a blend of topsoil and compost, creating an optimal environment for various shrubs to thrive. To enhance the visual cohesion of the space, the Railway Sleepers were painted in a colour matching the fence, which was also in the process of being replaced in certain sections.

This project exemplifies our commitment to creating multifunctional and aesthetically pleasing outdoor spaces. The combination of composite decking, LED lighting, and well-designed raised beds contributes to a garden that is not only visually appealing but also functional and conducive to plant growth.

title: Grey Sandstone Paving with Gym Area
description: Complementing this verdant expanse are three distinct patio areas, each crafted with Grey Sandstone for an elegant and cohesive look.
story: In the heart of a Victorian neighbourhood, we have utterly transformed this garden, turning it from a blank canvas into a captivating outdoor oasis. Our meticulous process began by clearing the dated and uneven lawn, setting the stage for a comprehensive makeover.

The centrepiece of this transformation is the lush new lawn, skilfully installed after levelling the entire area. Complementing this verdant expanse are three distinct patio areas, each crafted with Grey Sandstone for an elegant and cohesive look. The meticulous touch of Easy Joint grouting enhances both the aesthetics and durability, while charcoal block paving serves as a striking border, framing each patio with precision.

Adding dimension to the design, we introduced a raised flower bed at the rear of the garden. This thoughtful addition maximizes space utilization, featuring bevelled Railway Sleepers for a touch of rustic charm. Redwood trellises grace the walls, not only as a decorative element but also as a support system for climbers and roses, fostering a vibrant and natural ambiance.

Recognizing the diverse needs of our customer, we went above and beyond by incorporating outdoor gym mats. This strategic addition transforms the garden into a multifunctional space, offering a dedicated area for fitness pursuits while maintaining the aesthetic integrity of the overall design.

In essence, this Victorian garden has evolved into a harmonious blend of aesthetics and functionality, a testament to our commitment to creating outdoor spaces that not only captivate the eye but also cater to the diverse lifestyle preferences of our valued customers.

title: Artificial Grass with Playground using Rubber Barks
description: This meticulous process ensured the appropriate depth for the subsequent installation of a sub-base, paving the way for the strategic placement of artificial grass on multiple levels
story: For this project, we initiated a comprehensive transformation by utilizing a digger to re-level the terrain and remove excess soil from the rear end. This meticulous process ensured the appropriate depth for the subsequent installation of a sub-base, paving the way for the strategic placement of artificial grass on multiple levels. Beyond the functional aspects, these varied levels were incorporated for both design and aesthetic purposes, elevating the overall visual appeal of the outdoor space.

In keeping with our commitment to high-quality installations, the artificial grass was fitted on Grano Dust. This material not only exhibits superior weather resistance but also excels in water drainage, a crucial factor, particularly given the heavy rainfall typical of the UK climate.

To cater to diverse needs, a distinct area was crafted using purple Rubber Barks – a safety-oriented product ideal for playgrounds. This not only adds a vibrant touch but ensures a secure surface for recreational activities.

Adding character to the space, a small timber decking extension was seamlessly integrated, offering a charming spot for relaxation. Raised flower beds at the back contribute to the visual allure, while strategically placed slabs widen the path, enhancing accessibility and functionality.

title: Copper Marshalls Porcelain Patio
description: Transformation by removing a deteriorated timber decking than we levelled and marking out of the designated paving area and the chosen material was the elegant Copper Porcelain
story: Embarking on a comprehensive overhaul, we commenced the transformation by removing a deteriorated timber decking on the right-hand side. Simultaneously, we strategically dug for drainage, connecting it to the local stream, a practical solution for efficient water management at the rear of the house.

Following these essential preparations, we proceeded with the levelling and marking out of the designated paving area. The chosen material for the patio was the elegant Copper Porcelain paving supplied from Marshalls, coming in 1200mm by 600mm size. To frame the perimeter with a touch of sophistication, light-coloured porcelain blocks were employed as edging.

For a seamless and visually cohesive finish, the Marshalls Vitrified grouting product, matching the colour of the tiles, was applied. Introducing both form and function, in-ground armoured cables were installed to supply power to low-level path finder LED lights. These lights, embedded directly into the edging blocks, not only contribute to the aesthetic allure but also enhance the practicality and safety of the patio, especially during the evening hours.
This project exemplifies our commitment to creating outdoor spaces that seamlessly blend elegance with functionality, providing a visually captivating and well-lit area for our clients to enjoy.

title: Local Church Flower Beds Revamp
description: We revamped the rear path and garden of our local church in Kempston. We meticulously curated a list of over 150+ plants
story: Upon receiving a request to revamp the rear path and garden of our local church in Kempston, we engaged in a fruitful collaboration with a skilled garden landscape designer. Working together, we meticulously curated a list of over 150+ plants tailored to the approximately 40-square-meter area. Ensuring the optimal conditions for growth, we planted these selections in premium topsoil and species-specific compost.
To add a vertical dimension and encourage the healthy growth of climbers, we strategically installed trellises along the back wall and fences.
This not only provides structural support but also contributes to the overall aesthetics of the garden.

This collaborative effort was driven by a shared vision to create a welcoming and serene outdoor space that complements the church's environment. The result is a meticulously designed garden, carefully planned to bring natural beauty to the rear path. This project stands as a testament to the positive impact that thoughtful landscaping and community collaboration can have on shared spaces.

title: Mint Fossil and Astro Turf Garden Makeover
description: Mint Fossil Sandstone was chosen, introducing an element of sophistication and durabiliwe incorporated Astro Turf on one side. This artificial lawn was elegantly bordered with railway sleepersty.
story: Our comprehensive efforts aimed at expanding the available space and rejuvenating this neglected garden, reinforcing the left-side fence with closeboard panels as the first step. To achieve a balanced and visually appealing landscape, we then levelled the terrain, establishing three distinct levels seamlessly connected by carefully placed steps.

For the patio areas, Mint Fossil Sandstone was chosen, introducing an element of sophistication and durability. To address practical needs, a concrete shed base was strategically positioned at the bottom level, adding both functionality and structure to the space.

Responding to the client's desire for a harmonious blend of greenery, we incorporated Astro Turf on one side. This artificial lawn was elegantly bordered with railway sleepers, meeting the specific design preferences outlined by the customer. To ensure visual cohesion and long-lasting durability, we applied Easy Joint Buff for the grout, adding the perfect finishing touch.

The result is a transformed multi-level garden that not only meets practical needs but also combines various elements to create a visually appealing and well-integrated outdoor space. This project reflects our commitment to thoughtful landscaping, where aesthetics and functionality come together for a refreshed and inviting environment.

title: Limestone Paving and In-ground Trampoline
description: The redesigned space now accommodates a dedicated hot tub area, a strategically placed shed base at the garden's bottom, and an in-ground trampoline
story: In this transformation, we initiated a comprehensive overhaul by clearing the entire garden section and ensuring a level foundation. The redesigned space now accommodates a dedicated hot tub area, a strategically placed shed base at the garden's bottom, and an in-ground trampoline – providing both relaxation and fun for the entire family.

To enhance the functionality and aesthetics of the revamped space, we incorporated LED lights along the path, ensuring visibility during the night. Additionally, we paid careful attention to detail by painting the railway sleepers in a colour that seamlessly complements the limestone, aligning with the customer's specific preferences.
This project stands as a testament to our commitment to creating outdoor spaces that are not only visually appealing but also cater to the unique needs and desires of our valued customers.

title: York Stone Paving with Vegetable Patches
description: York Stone paving, complemented by granite bricks mirroring both colour and rough texture, served as the foundation of the transformation
story: In the rejuvenation of this outdoor space, our first step involved the meticulous removal of concrete, old tiles, and existing flower beds. Guided by the vision of our elderly customer, we prioritized creating a low-maintenance and easily accessible area.

The introduction of York Stone paving, complemented by granite bricks mirroring both colour and rough texture, served as the foundation of the transformation. Empty spaces were thoughtfully filled with artificial grass, seamlessly bonded to the surface underneath, providing a lush and green ambiance without the hassle of maintenance.

In response to our customer's desire for simplicity and convenience, we designed three distinct small vegetable patches, adding a touch of practicality to the aesthetics. Addressing the need for illumination without compromising the garden's cable-free appeal, solar-powered lights were delicately fitted into the paving, enhancing the charm of the space during the evening hours.

This project not only reflects our dedication to translating customer visions into reality but also showcases our commitment to creating outdoor environments that prioritize accessibility, ease of maintenance, and the unique preferences of each individual client.

title: Grey Composite Decking with Farm Fence
description: Installation of new smart grey Composite Decking, custom fitted to measurements and complete with a safety guarded back rail, with premium timber
story: Commencing with the dismantling of a pergola that veiled the aging timber decking, we embarked on a comprehensive rejuvenation. The initial step involved the installation of a sturdy frame, meticulously prepared to support the upcoming Composite Decking. Opting for Grey PVC boards, we introduced a contemporary touch, accentuated by lighter-coloured facias that added a contrasting allure to the entire structure.

As part of the transformation, the dilapidated farm fence was replaced with a bespoke one, crafted to not only enhance safety but also to elevate the visual appeal. Extended wires were attached to the end posts, ensuring a secure environment for children and pets, whilst blocking wildlife at the back of the property from entering the garden.

In addition to the decking overhaul, we reimagined the spatial layout by relocating the customer's trampoline. This involved the installation of a heavy-duty membrane layer, topped with rubber barks, creating a safe and resilient surface around the deck. This thoughtful modification not only optimized the use of space but also enhanced the overall functionality of the outdoor area.

This project is a testament to our commitment to comprehensive transformations, encompassing decking installations, fencing upgrades, and spatial reconfigurations. The result is a harmonious blend of aesthetics, safety, and practicality, offering the customer an inviting outdoor space tailored to their needs.

title: Rounded Sleepers and Autumn Sandstone
description: The patio area was defined and enhanced with the use of these sandstone slabs, complemented by a bordering edge crafted from Autumn block paving
story: Transforming the previous landscape, characterized by a simple lawn and a small concrete pathway along the side of the house, the customer's vision was to create a welcoming patio area while minimizing the lawn and bordering the flower beds at the back. To bring this vision to life, we executed the installation using Autumn Brown Sandstone slabs.

The patio area was defined and enhanced with the use of these sandstone slabs, complemented by a bordering edge crafted from Autumn block paving. This not only provided a cohesive visual appeal but also added a touch of elegance to the outdoor space.

The existing lawn underwent a complete overhaul – it was meticulously ripped apart and replaced with fresh turf, laid atop a layer of screened topsoil. Introducing Rounded Sleepers, we created a structured border from side to side, elegantly outlining the flower bed along its entire length.

While the project may have been straightforward for us, the attention to detail did not go unnoticed. The customer was delighted with the outcome, a testament to our commitment to transforming outdoor spaces with precision and aesthetic finesse.
